text: One of the best pediatric clinics in Chiang Mai. The staff at the counter are friendly and polite. The doctor explains the causes and symptoms of illness in great detail.
This is the best children's clinic in Chiang Mai.
The doctor is kind and the staff are friendly. I recommend this place.
